offence_note: Break and enter dwelling, escape custody, resist arrest, fail to attend court
sentence_quote: In relation to the break and enter into a dwelling, the Court imposes a sentence of three (3) years imprisonment
note: Other counts concurrent (3m, 3m, 1m); victim surcharge declined; s.110 prohibition 5 years.

offence_note: Sexual interference, invitation to touching, child pornography, breach of release order
sentence_quote: The appellant seeks leave to appeal a global sentence of 11 years and 3 months, less credit for pre-sentence custody
note: Global sentence already reflects 9-month Duncan deduction; s.743.21 non-communication order upheld.

offence_note: Manslaughter with firearm, robbery, use of imitation firearm
sentence_quote: Based on the totality principle, I reduce your sentence to 12 years.
note: 9 years manslaughter plus 5 consecutive for robbery, reduced to 12 for totality.

offence_note: Robbery and evading police while operating motor vehicle
sentence_quote: For the robbery count, I sentence you to two and a half years (30 months) in jail. For the count of evading police while driving a motor vehicle I sentence you to three months in jail, to be served consecutively.
note: 30 months plus 3 months consecutive; victim surcharge waived; co-accused sentenced separately (6 months).

offence_note: Offences not stated; young person sentenced as adult
note: Brief endorsement; offences and sentence not described; adult sentence for young person upheld.

offence_note: Possession for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: the sentence for possession for the purposes is reduced to eighteen months imprisonment. The probation order is set aside.
note: Trial effective sentence 27 months after pre-trial custody; unclear if 18 months is effective or gross.

sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence is varied to provide for a period of parole ineligibility of 16 years.
note: Parole ineligibility reduced from 20 to 16 years.

sentence_quote: set aside the term of imprisonment imposed, and substitute a conditional sentence of 12 months with the conditions to include those in addition to the compulsory requirements that the Crown proposes
note: Other: 6 months house arrest within CSO; restitution approximate, trial order presumably stands.

offence_note: Impaired driving causing bodily harm, failing to remain, dangerous driving
sentence_quote: Justice B. Thomas imposed a six-month custodial sentence consisting of: Count 1 – three months; Count 3 – one month consecutive; Count 4 – one month consecutive; and Count 5 – one month consecutive.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; conditional sentence appeal did not arise, so sentence stands.

offence_note: Manslaughter and robbery with a firearm
sentence_quote: Mr. Tomljenovic, I sentence you to 12 years imprisonment for Count 1, the manslaughter of Mr. Singh.
note: Robbery 6 years concurrent; victim surcharge waived; mental health and addiction rejected as mitigating.
